features.description: State manager: read/write pipeline_state.json, enforce valid state transitions, track per-track status
Error handler: categorize failures (network/parse/validation/generation/dependency), append to pipeline_log.jsonl, track retry counts, decide retry vs escalate vs skip
DOD validator: per-stage validation checking output files exist and meet quality thresholds, returns pass/fail with reasons
Checkpoint handler: log to pending_review.json, CLI for human approve/reject, orchestrator skips blocked tracks
Orchestrator loop: read state, select next (track_id, stage), dispatch to stage, validate DOD, transition state, handle errors, round-robin multiple tracks
Stage 1: scrape Billboard Hot 100, parse rank/title/artist, deduplicate, write tracks_manifest.json
Stage 2: search YouTube via yt-dlp, download best audio as MP3 to raw/{track_id}.mp3
Stage 3: extract BPM, key, structure, energy curve, chords, duration — write analysis JSON
Stage 4: Demucs htdemucs split into vocals/drums/bass/other WAVs, normalize to -1 dBFS
Stage 5: HP 80Hz, room reverb, 1/8 delay synced to BPM, extract hook section via pedalboard
Stage 6: prompt Suno V5 via APIPASS for deep house instrumental matching analysis BPM/key/chords
Stage 7: time-stretch/pitch-shift vocals, place hook at drop, layer vocals over instrumentation
Stage 8: sidechain compression, EQ carving for vocals, bus compression, 24-bit 44.1kHz output
Stage 9: sub cleanup, multiband compression, loudness to -9 LUFS, true peak limit -0.3 dBTP, 320kbps MP3
Stage 10: bundle final MP3, metadata JSON, analysis JSON, SHA256 checksum into output/{track_id}/
